subject: general
question: Under which Section of the Telecommunications Act, 2023, was the Universal Service Obligation Fund renamed as Digital Bharat Nidhi?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Section 24(1)**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The** Universal Service Obligation Fund (USOF**) was renamed as Digital Bharat Nidhi (DBN) under Section 24(1) of the Telecommunications Act, 2023. 
 
• The **USOF was established under the Indian Telegraph Act of 1885. **
